tasks.title: ngv2/gate_executor.py — deterministic may_confirm gate executor enforcing the four orphaned NobleGreed confirmation gates per phase transition
acceptance_criteria: New pure module ngv2/gate_executor.py exists, emitted whole-file, importing classify_poc_authenticity, classify_detonation_evidence, verify_sink_present, assess_sink_reachability from their live ngv2.* modules.

Exposes exactly one public function run_gates(from_phase: str, to_phase: str, evidence: dict) -> dict returning the fixed three-key shape {"advance": bool, "blocked_by": list[str], "results": dict[str, dict]}.

Applies the transition->gate map: ("verify","poc")->poc_authenticity; ("poc","detonate")->poc_authenticity AND detonation_evidence; ("detonate","novelty")->detonation_evidence AND sink_presence AND sink_reachability; any other transition->no gate.

advance is True iff every applicable gate was actually called and every called gate returned may_confirm == True; a transition with no applicable gate advances with empty blocked_by and empty results.
Fail-closed: a missing required evidence key means the gate is not called, "<gate_name>:missing_evidence" is recorded in blocked_by, advance is False, and no KeyError escapes.

blocked_by is the ordered, de-duplicated list of stable gate names (bare name for may_confirm False, "<name>:missing_evidence" for missing key); results maps each CALLED gate's stable name to its full return dict.
Committed oracle tests/ngv2/test_gate_executor_wired.py goes GREEN under `python -m pytest tests/ngv2/test_gate_executor_wired.py -q`; no test is authored or altered.

spec.objective: Create the new pure, deterministic module ngv2/gate_executor.py that maps a phase transition (from_phase, to_phase) to its applicable may_confirm gates, calls each over the evidence dict, reads each gate's boolean may_confirm field, and returns a fixed-shape advance/block decision — so the four orphaned NobleGreed confirmation gates (poc_authenticity, detonation_evidence, sink_presence, sink_reachability) are enforced automatically between stages instead of being wired into no transition.
functional_requirements: Define exactly one public function run_gates(from_phase: str, to_phase: str, evidence: dict) -> dict that returns the fixed three-key dict {"advance": bool, "blocked_by": list[str], "results": dict[str, dict]} and adds no second public function and changes no key.

Encode the transition->applicable-gate map exactly: ("verify","poc")->[poc_authenticity]; ("poc","detonate")->[poc_authenticity, detonation_evidence]; ("detonate","novelty")->[detonation_evidence, sink_presence, sink_reachability]; every other ordered pair->no applicable gate (advance True, empty blocked_by, empty results). Each gate is called with its specified evidence args: classify_poc_authenticity(evidence["poc_source"], evidence["target_import_names"]), classify_detonation_evidence(evidence["detonation_report"]), verify_sink_present(evidence["target_source"], evidence["expected_signature"]), assess_sink_reachability(evidence["sink_name"], evidence["call_sites"]).

For each applicable gate whose required evidence key(s) are present, import-and-call the live gate function (do NOT re-implement its logic) and read its top-level boolean may_confirm field; store the gate's full return dict in results under its stable name (poc_authenticity, detonation_evidence, sink_presence, sink_reachability).

Compute advance as True if and only if EVERY applicable gate was actually called (no required evidence missing) AND every called gate returned may_confirm == True; record any gate with may_confirm False as its bare stable name in blocked_by; build blocked_by as an ordered, de-duplicated list.

Apply the fail-closed rule for missing required evidence: detect missing keys WITHOUT triggering a KeyError, skip the gate call, append "<gate_name>:missing_evidence" to blocked_by, and set advance False — a missing key is a block, never a crash; keep the module pure (stdlib + the four ngv2 gate imports only, no I/O, no network, no wall-clock, no randomness, no module-level side effects).
spec.interfaces: def run_gates(from_phase: str, to_phase: str, evidence: dict) -> dict — returns {"advance": bool, "blocked_by": list[str], "results": dict[str, dict]}. Imports: from ngv2.poc_authenticity_gate import classify_poc_authenticity; from ngv2.detonation_evidence_gate import classify_detonation_evidence; from ngv2.sink_presence_gate import verify_sink_present; from ngv2.sink_reachability_gate import assess_sink_reachability. Stable gate names used in both results keys and blocked_by: poc_authenticity, detonation_evidence, sink_presence, sink_reachability.
edge_cases: (a) ("poc","detonate") with a self-contained-mock poc_source (local def vulnerable(...), imports nothing from the target) plus a live detonation_report -> poc_authenticity may_confirm False -> advance False, "poc_authenticity" in blocked_by.

(b) ("detonate","novelty") with a live detonation_report + present expected_signature but call_sites all constant string literals (e.g. ["os.system('ls -la')"]) -> sink_reachability may_confirm False -> advance False, "sink_reachability" in blocked_by.

(c) ("detonate","novelty") with a live detonation_report (method="http_request", ran_target=True, observed_runtime_effect=True, self_hosted_mock=False) + expected_signature present as live code in target_source + a non-constant call site (e.g. ["os.system(user_input)"]) -> all three gates may_confirm True -> advance True, blocked_by empty.
(d) ("source","hunt") (no applicable may_confirm gate) -> advance True, blocked_by empty, results empty.
(e) ("poc","detonate") missing evidence["poc_source"] -> poc_authenticity not called -> advance False, blocked_by contains "poc_authenticity:missing_evidence", no KeyError escapes.
non_goals: INTEGRATION testing is out of scope for this leaf: do NOT author or modify any integration or e2e test; this pure executor is verified solely by its pre-committed authoritative unit oracle tests/ngv2/test_gate_executor_wired.py. Author NO new test and alter NO existing test.
Do NOT edit ngv2/session_gate.py or reshape its _HANDLERS, and do NOT list session_gate.py or the conductor file in files_touched — build gate_executor.py as a NEW standalone module.

Do NOT re-implement the four gates' internal logic; only call them and read may_confirm. Do NOT run/fuzz/detonate any PoC, make network calls, spawn subprocesses, read the filesystem, parse target source, import the target, use the wall-clock, or use randomness.

Do NOT decide severity, dedupe findings, persist sessions, or format submissions. Do NOT add a second public function, change the three-key return shape, add a new third-party dependency, or introduce module-level side effects.
spec.implementation_notes:
Keep the module tiny and pure. Suggested shape: a module-level constant mapping each applicable transition to an ordered list of (stable_name, required_evidence_keys, caller) triples — e.g. for ("poc","detonate"): poc_authenticity requires ["poc_source","target_import_names"] and calls classify_poc_authenticity(evidence["poc_source"], evidence["target_import_names"]); detonation_evidence requires ["detonation_report"] and calls classify_detonation_evidence(evidence["detonation_report"]); for ("detonate","novelty"): detonation_evidence, sink_presence requires ["target_source","expected_signature"] calling verify_sink_present, sink_reachability requires ["sink_name","call_sites"] calling assess_sink_reachability. In run_gates: look up the applicable gate list for (from_phase, to_phase); if none, return {"advance": True, "blocked_by": [], "results": {}}. Otherwise iterate in declared order; for each gate, if any required key is NOT in evidence, append f"{name}:missing_evidence" to blocked_by and continue (do not call); else call the gate, store its full return dict in results[name], and if bool(result["may_confirm"]) is False append name to blocked_by. advance = (len(applicable) gates all called) and (blocked_by is empty); concretely advance is True iff blocked_by ended up empty AND no gate was skipped — which simplifies to advance = (blocked_by == []). De-duplicate blocked_by while preserving first-seen order before returning. Read keys via membership test (`if key in evidence`) so no KeyError can escape. The committed oracle tests/ngv2/test_gate_executor_wired.py importing run_gates from the live ngv2.gate_executor module IS the wiring/reachability contract — making it import cleanly and pass is how the module is wired into the conductor transition path.

Instead accept any timestamp, seed, or clock as an EXPLICIT parameter with a deterministic default (the oracle injects it, e.g. via now_fn / make_scripted_clock), so the same inputs always produce the same output.

## tests/ngv2/test_gate_executor_wired.py
```python
"""RED oracle for ngv2.gate_executor -- the deterministic GATE EXECUTOR that
applies the right may_confirm gates per phase transition and decides advance/block.

The audit found the four may_confirm gates (classify_poc_authenticity,
classify_detonation_evidence, verify_sink_present, assess_sink_reachability) are
ORPHANED: defined but wired into no transition in ngv2/session_gate.py's
_HANDLERS, so false-positive findings (mock PoCs, patched sinks, constant-only
sinks, static-assert "detonations") were never blocked between stages. This
module is the executor that selects the applicable gates for a transition, calls
them over an evidence dict, reads each gate's `may_confirm`, and returns
{"advance": bool, "blocked_by": list[str], "results": dict[str, dict]}.

It is PURE over the evidence dict (imports the four gate functions and calls
them); deterministic -> differential-fuzzable. Importing run_gates from the live
ngv2.gate_executor module is the wiring/reachability contract this oracle pins.

Transition -> applicable may_confirm gates:
  ("verify","poc")     -> poc_authenticity
  ("poc","detonate")   -> poc_authenticity AND detonation_evidence
  ("detonate","novelty") -> detonation_evidence AND sink_presence AND sink_reachability
  any other transition -> none (advance True, blocked_by empty, results empty)

advance == True iff EVERY applicable gate was CALLED and every one returned
may_confirm True. FAIL-CLOSED: a missing required evidence key blocks (gate not
called, "<gate>:missing_evidence" in blocked_by, advance False) -- never a KeyError.
"""
import json

from ngv2.gate_executor import run_gates

RESULT_KEYS = {"advance", "blocked_by", "results"}

# --- realistic evidence fragments the REAL gates classify as specified -------

# A self-contained mock PoC: defines a local vulnish def, imports nothing from
# the target -> classify_poc_authenticity -> mode self_contained_mock -> may_confirm False.
_MOCK_POC_SOURCE = (
    "def vulnerable(request):\n"
    "    return request['q']\n"
    "vulnerable({'q': 1})\n"
)
# A real-target PoC: imports the target package and references it -> real_target -> may_confirm True.
_REAL_POC_SOURCE = (
    "import target_pkg\n"
    "def go():\n"
    "    return target_pkg.exploit('payload')\n"
)
_TARGET_NAMES = ["target_pkg"]

# A live detonation report -> classify_detonation_evidence -> live_execution -> may_confirm True.
_LIVE_DETONATION = {
    "method": "http_request",
    "ran_target": True,
    "observed_runtime_effect": True,
    "self_hosted_mock": False,
}

# Target source that contains the expected signature as LIVE code (not comment/string).
_TARGET_SOURCE = (
    "def handler(req):\n"
    "    os.system(req.params['cmd'])\n"
    "    return 200\n"
)
_PRESENT_SIGNATURE = "os.system(req.params['cmd'])"

# call_sites: a non-constant arg reaches the sink -> reachable -> may_confirm True.
_REACHABLE_CALL_SITES = ["os.system(user_input)"]
# call_sites: only a constant string literal -> constant_only -> may_confirm False.
_CONSTANT_CALL_SITES = ["os.system('ls -la')"]
_SINK_NAME = "os.system"


# --- contract: fixed-shape dict ---------------------------------------------
def test_return_shape_contract():
    res = run_gates("source", "hunt", {})
    assert set(res) == RESULT_KEYS
    assert isinstance(res["advance"], bool)
    assert isinstance(res["blocked_by"], list)
    assert isinstance(res["results"], dict)


# --- (d) no applicable gate -> advance True, empty blocked_by/results --------
def test_source_hunt_no_gate_advances():
    res = run_gates("source", "hunt", {})
    assert res["advance"] is True
    assert res["blocked_by"] == []
    assert res["results"] == {}


def test_unknown_transition_advances_no_gate():
    res = run_gates("novelty", "report", {"anything": 1})
    assert res["advance"] is True
    assert res["blocked_by"] == []
    assert res["results"] == {}


# --- (a) ("poc","detonate") with a mock PoC -> poc_authenticity blocks -------
def test_poc_detonate_mock_poc_blocks_advance():
    evidence = {
        "poc_source": _MOCK_POC_SOURCE,
        "target_import_names": _TARGET_NAMES,
        "detonation_report": _LIVE_DETONATION,
    }
    res = run_gates("poc", "detonate", evidence)
    assert res["advance"] is False
    assert "poc_authenticity" in res["blocked_by"]
    # the gate WAS called -> its full dict is recorded under results
    assert res["results"]["poc_authenticity"]["may_confirm"] is False


# --- (b) ("detonate","novelty") constant-only call sites -> reachability block
def test_detonate_novelty_constant_only_callsites_blocks():
    evidence = {
        "detonation_report": _LIVE_DETONATION,
        "target_source": _TARGET_SOURCE,
        "expected_signature": _PRESENT_SIGNATURE,
        "sink_name": _SINK_NAME,
        "call_sites": _CONSTANT_CALL_SITES,
    }
    res = run_gates("detonate", "novelty", evidence)
    assert res["advance"] is False
    assert "sink_reachability" in res["blocked_by"]
    assert res["results"]["sink_reachability"]["may_confirm"] is False
    # the other two applicable gates pass, so they are NOT in blocked_by
    assert "detonation_evidence" not in res["blocked_by"]
    assert "sink_presence" not in res["blocked_by"]


# --- (c) ("detonate","novelty") all three gates pass -> advance True ---------
def test_detonate_novelty_all_gates_pass_advances():
    evidence = {
        "detonation_report": _LIVE_DETONATION,
        "target_source": _TARGET_SOURCE,
        "expected_signature": _PRESENT_SIGNATURE,
        "sink_name": _SINK_NAME,
        "call_sites": _REACHABLE_CALL_SITES,
    }
    res = run_gates("detonate", "novelty", evidence)
    assert res["advance"] is True
    assert res["blocked_by"] == []
    assert res["results"]["detonation_evidence"]["may_confirm"] is True
    assert res["results"]["sink_presence"]["may_confirm"] is True
    assert res["results"]["sink_reachability"]["may_confirm"] is True


# --- (e) ("poc","detonate") missing poc_source -> fail closed ----------------
def test_poc_detonate_missing_poc_source_fails_closed():
    evidence = {
        # poc_source intentionally absent
        "target_import_names": _TARGET_NAMES,
        "detonation_report": _LIVE_DETONATION,
    }
    res = run_gates("poc", "detonate", evidence)
    assert res["advance"] is False
    assert "poc_authenticity:missing_evidence" in res["blocked_by"]
    # a skipped gate must NOT appear in results (it was never called)
    assert "poc_authenticity" not in res["results"]


def test_verify_poc_real_target_advances():
    evidence = {
        "poc_source": _REAL_POC_SOURCE,
        "target_import_names": _TARGET_NAMES,
    }
    res = run_gates("verify", "poc", evidence)
    assert res["advance"] is True
    assert res["blocked_by"] == []
    assert res["results"]["poc_authenticity"]["may_confirm"] is True


def test_poc_detonate_real_poc_and_live_detonation_advances():
    evidence = {
        "poc_source": _REAL_POC_SOURCE,
        "target_import_names": _TARGET_NAMES,
        "detonation_report": _LIVE_DETONATION,
    }
    res = run_gates("poc", "detonate", evidence)
    assert res["advance"] is True
    assert res["blocked_by"] == []
    assert res["results"]["poc_authenticity"]["may_confirm"] is True
    assert res["results"]["detonation_evidence"]["may_confirm"] is True


# --- fail-closed: a non-live detonation report blocks at ("poc","detonate") --
def test_poc_detonate_static_assertion_detonation_blocks():
    evidence = {
        "poc_source": _REAL_POC_SOURCE,
        "target_import_names": _TARGET_NAMES,
        "detonation_report": {"method": "regex_assert"},
    }
    res = run_gates("poc", "detonate", evidence)
    assert res["advance"] is False
    assert "detonation_evidence" in res["blocked_by"]
    # the real-target poc gate still passed
    assert "poc_authenticity" not in res["blocked_by"]


# --- determinism -------------------------------------------------------------
def test_output_is_deterministic():
    evidence = {
        "detonation_report": _LIVE_DETONATION,
        "target_source": _TARGET_SOURCE,
        "expected_signature": _PRESENT_SIGNATURE,
        "sink_name": _SINK_NAME,
        "call_sites": _REACHABLE_CALL_SITES,
    }
    a = json.dumps(run_gates("detonate", "novelty", evidence), sort_keys=True)
    b = json.dumps(run_gates("detonate", "novelty", evidence), sort_keys=True)
    assert a == b

```

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Evidence dicts mirroring the brief's committed-oracle cases: a self-contained-mock poc_source (local def vulnerable, no target imports) and a target-importing authentic poc_source; a live detonation_report (method="http_request", ran_target=True, observed_runtime_effect=True, self_hosted_mock=False) versus a static-assert report; target_source containing/omitting expected_signature as live code; call_sites that are all constant literals (e.g. ["os.system('ls -la')"]) versus a non-constant call site (e.g. ["os.system(user_input)"]).
